content.text: Confirmed zero import graph edges with madge before scheduling the delete.

The pre-2025 editor shell left behind 14 CSS modules under packages/editor/src/shell-legacy that no component imports. They still get swept into Storybook's CSS graph and confuse new hires scanning the tree.
Delete the unused modules, remove any orphan className string references in dead test helpers, and confirm the editor production bundle size drops by the measured ~11 KiB gzip.
